tasks.title: Project canonical stage task lists from real workflow evidence
tasks.description: Refactor the stage-state read model so each stage returns one user-visible task list containing only real workflow tasks and one separate check list. Filter obsolete placeholder rows such as Plan's seeded abstract tasks, map real Plan/Build/Check/Integrate task identities to stable user-facing titles, and stop seeding non-executable placeholder tasks for new stage runs where possible.
acceptanceCriteria: StageStateService no longer returns `read-context`, `design-solution`, `write-design`, `write-specs`, or `write-tasks` as visible Plan tasks when no matching real workflow task evidence exists
Plan stage visible tasks resolve to the real artifact task set (`proposal`, `specs`, `design`, `tasks`, `self-review`) plus real runtime repair/health tasks when present
Build stage visible tasks resolve from `tasks.json` plus real runtime repair tasks such as `fix-build-health` without introducing a separate planned/dynamic user model
Checks remain in a separate list from tasks for all projected stages
New stage runs do not persist obsolete placeholder tasks as the source of truth for user-visible stage progress
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the first pass schema-light: fix semantics in projection before considering any deeper storage cleanup.

tasks.title: Expose reason-aware stage-state API contract
tasks.description: Update the stage-state API and shared backend/frontend types so the response is explicitly the canonical user-visible workflow view rather than raw `stage_tasks` rows. Add optional task explanation metadata such as `reason` and `causedBy`, preserve existing task/check evidence fields, and populate explanation metadata for runtime-added repair/rebase/retry tasks wherever the current workflow can derive it reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/issues/:number/stage-state` returns the projected stage task/check view produced by StageStateService rather than exposing placeholder rows verbatim
Shared task types support optional `reason` and `causedBy` metadata without removing task evidence fields such as attempts, artifacts, output, and timestamps

At least one runtime-added task path such as `repair-plan-artifacts`, `fix-build-health`, `fix-review-findings`, `repair-merge`, or rebase-backed integrate work can surface a human-readable explanation in stage-state output
All in-repo stage-state consumers compile against the updated contract without ad hoc frontend status remapping
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer backward-compatible field additions over a full response rename so existing in-repo callers can migrate in one change.

tasks.title: Render Issue Detail from the real stage task/check model
tasks.description: Update `PipelineView` and `TaskProgressPanel` so both render the same canonical stage task list and check list from `useIssueStageState()`. Show task explanation metadata inline or in details, keep checks distinct from tasks, and ensure Plan/Build/Check/Integrate all display real workflow tasks instead of placeholder rows or mixed internal concepts.
acceptanceCriteria: PipelineView no longer shows obsolete Plan placeholder tasks when stage-state also contains the real Plan artifact tasks
TaskProgressPanel and PipelineView render the same task list for the same issue stage and can both show runtime-added tasks such as `fix-build-health` when present in stage-state data
Checks remain visibly separate from tasks in the Issue Detail UI and approval continues to render as decision state rather than as a synthetic task
Task details can show available evidence such as attempts, artifacts, output, or explanation metadata without promoting logs/checks/session activity into top-level tasks
Frontend typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not reintroduce frontend-owned task classification logic; the backend projection remains the single source of truth.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage for placeholder filtering and runtime-added tasks
tasks.description: Add backend and frontend regression coverage for the contradictory task-list cases behind #180. Verify placeholder filtering, real Plan artifact task rendering, runtime repair-task visibility with reason metadata, and consistency between `PipelineView` and `TaskProgressPanel` when both consume the same stage-state response.
acceptanceCriteria: A backend test proves Plan placeholder rows mixed with real Plan task evidence are projected as only the real task list
A backend or route-level test proves a runtime-added repair or retry task can appear in stage-state output with `reason` or `causedBy` metadata when that metadata is available
A frontend test proves PipelineView and TaskProgressPanel both render the same stage task list from shared stage-state data
A frontend test proves checks do not render as top-level tasks in the task list
Relevant test suites pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Favor narrow fixtures that model the exact mixed-placeholder and runtime-repair states described in the issue.
